appeal for spiritual and finan- cial support so that the life-giving work of overseas missions and missiona ries can continue. for world mis- sion day 2026, which marks the centenary of a celebration established by pius xi that is very dear to the church, pope leo has chosen the theme “one in christ, united in mission.” following the jubilee year, he wishes to encourage the whole church to continue its missionary journey with and zeal in the holy spirit. this requires hearts united in christ, reconciled communities and, in everyone, a wi llingness to cooperate with generosity and trust.
